attempts.summary: Configured node1 (SONiC) with routed addresses on its two data-plane segments (eth1=192.168.1.1/24 toward node2, eth2=192.168.2.1/24 toward node3), enabled IPv4 forwarding, and set static addressing/routes on node2 and node3 (via NetworkManager) so they reach each other through node1. Persistence was achieved via a SONiC interfaces.d drop-in and sysctl.d config (survives node1's boot-time config engine which only manages eth0), and NetworkManager connection profiles on node2/node3. Verified end-to-end ping in both directions, then restarted node1 via native reboot, confirmed its boot_id changed (82b18f3b... -> 70971868...), confirmed eth1/eth2 addresses and forwarding sysctls returned automatically, and re-verified node2<->node3 ping worked again without manual intervention.
